title: 第19章 恶魔术士第20章 及时的援军
slug: 请不要给基础技能附魔奇怪的词条
content_zh:
;;
这三头怪物根的目标只有一个——金色的乌龟壳。
轰！轰！轰！
三个巨大的绿色火球喷吐而出，狠狠地轰击在【大地之壁】上。
坚不可摧的光幕剧烈颤抖起来，表面浮现出大片的裂纹。卷轴毕竟只是死物，在邪能面前，撑不了太久。
“该死！”
光幕内，雷恩的脸色终于变了。
如果护盾破了，他可能无法顾及内圈的防线。
“不能让他继续施法！”
雷恩做出了决断。
“你们守住里面！我去宰了那个杂种！”
雷恩怒吼一声，双脚猛踏马车顶棚。整个人像是一枚金色的炮弹，直接穿过了护盾，带着一往无前的气势，凌空扑向那个黑袍术士。
手中的双手巨剑在斗气的灌注下，暴涨出三米长的金色剑芒。
【战技·崩山】
这一击，势大力沉，足以劈开岩石。
“去死！”
雷恩落地，巨剑横扫，直接将一头扑上来的熔岩猎犬拍飞了出去，那怪物身上的火焰都被这一击拍散了大半。
紧接着，他借势冲锋，逼得术士后退。
战局似乎在向好的方向发展。
雷恩压制住了术士，护盾内的危机暂时解除。

但是。
一直游离在战场边缘、此时正躲在一堆货物后面“补刀”的维克多，却突然感觉后颈一阵发凉。
他的【盲斗剑术】正在疯狂报警。
那种感觉，就像是有某种看不见的、比冰块还要寒冷的东西，正贴着地面，以一种违背物理常识的速度，切入了雷恩和术士的战圈。
“不对劲……还有一个！”
维克多的瞳孔猛缩。
就在雷恩一剑逼退术士，旧力已尽、新力未生的那个瞬间。
雷恩身后的影子，突然“站”了起来。
那不是比喻。
是真的有一道漆黑的人影，从雷恩脚下的影子里剥离了出来。
那是【游荡者】！
“小心身后！”
协会的护卫们惊恐地尖叫起来，但声音哪有刀快？
两把漆黑如墨、涂满了剧毒的匕首，像是毒蛇的毒牙，无声无息地刺向了雷恩后背铠甲的缝隙——那是腰椎和脖颈的位置。
噗嗤。
虽然雷恩在最后关头凭着战士的直觉强行扭动了一下身体，避开了瘫痪腰椎的致命一击，但另一把匕首还是狠狠地扎进了他的左肩。
“滚！！”
雷恩发出一声受伤野兽般的咆哮，斗气爆发，将来袭的阴影震退。
但他受伤了。
content_en:
;;
These three monsters have only one goal - the golden turtle shell.
boom! boom! boom!
Three huge green fireballs spit out and hit the [Wall of the Earth] fiercely.
The indestructible light curtain trembled violently, and large cracks appeared on the surface. After all, the scroll is just a dead object and cannot last long in the face of evil energy.
"Damn it!"
Within the light curtain, Ren's expression finally changed.
If the shield is broken, he may not be able to take care of the inner circle of defense.
"We can't let him continue to cast spells!"
Renn made a decision.
"You guys hold on inside! I'll kill that bastard!"
Ren roared angrily and slammed his feet on the roof of the carriage. The whole figure was like a golden cannonball, directly passing through the shield, and with an indomitable momentum, it volleyed towards the black-robed warlock.
The two-handed giant sword in his hand exploded with a three-meter-long golden sword light under the infusion of fighting spirit.
[Combat Technique·Collapse of Mountain]
This blow was powerful enough to split the rock.
"Go to hell!"
Ren landed and swept his giant sword away, directly sending the lava hound flying away. Most of the flames on the monster were scattered by this blow.
Then, he took advantage of the situation and charged, forcing the warlock to retreat.
The war situation seems to be developing in a good direction.
Renn suppressed the Warlock, and the crisis in the shield was temporarily lifted.
but.
Victor, who had been wandering around the edge of the battlefield and was currently hiding behind a pile of goods to "make up for it", suddenly felt a chill on the back of his neck.
His [Blind Fighting Swordsmanship] is calling the police like crazy.
It felt like there was something invisible, colder than ice, sticking to the ground, cutting into the battle circle between Ren and Warlock at a speed that defied common sense in physics.
"Something's wrong...there's another one!"
Victor's pupils shrank sharply.
At that moment when Ren forced the warlock back with one sword, his old strength was exhausted and new strength was yet to be born.
The shadow behind Ren suddenly stood up.
That's not a metaphor.
There was really a dark figure that peeled out from the shadow under Ren's feet.
That's [Wanderer]!
"Watch your back!"
The guards of the association screamed in horror, but how could their voices be as sharp as a knife?
Two daggers, as black as ink and coated with poison, like the fangs of poisonous snakes, stabbed silently into the gap in the armor on Ren's back - the position of his lumbar spine and neck.
Pfft.
Although Renn used his warrior intuition to twist his body at the last moment and avoid the fatal blow that paralyzed his lumbar spine, another dagger still pierced his left shoulder.
"Get out!!"
Ren let out a roar like a wounded beast, and his fighting spirit exploded, knocking back the incoming shadow.
But he was injured.
